label: Risk difference: p-hat treated minus p-hat control
Standard error of the risk difference: the square root of p-hat treated times one minus p-hat treated over n treated, plus p-hat control times one minus p-hat control over n control
Ninety-five percent confidence interval: the risk difference plus or minus 1.96 times its standard error
Risk ratio: p-hat treated divided by p-hat control
Number needed to treat: one divided by the absolute risk reduction, p-hat control minus p-hat treated
